Calling export_csv later never runs exporter (it registered the function and handed it back unchanged), so the route is the import, not a hop from the decorated function. the inner function the factory returns is reached the same way, one hop further out: it is what actually wraps the handler
the hop is named for what it is: the decoration runs at import, and the answer says so rather than selling it as a resolved call
